RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, November 30, 2010/Agrahayana 9, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Finance; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Panchayati Raj; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Rural Development; Shipping)
Total number of questions — 20
86
Tightening of home loan norms
*281. SHRI T.M.
SELVAGANAPATHI: Will the Minister
of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Reserve
Bank of India (RBI) has taken a decision to
tighten the norms for home loans;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that sharp
rise in the asset prices in a short time was
the main reason for making the home loan
norms tight; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Measures to discourage people from
using tobacco
*282. SHRI A VINASH RAI
KHANNA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a survey has been conducted
by the Global Adult Tobacco Survey
(GA TS) regarding use of tobacco;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that some of the
States/UTs namely, Punjab, Goa and
Chandigarh, have the lowest tobacco user
rate;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether Government is planning to
extend the measures for encouraging low
use of tobacco to other States;
(f) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(g) the measures Government will take
to deter people from using tobacco
products?
ED’s raid on EMMAR-MGF
company
†*283. SHRI NARESH CHANDRA
AGRAWAL: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether EMMAR-MGF company
had been raided in 2009-10;
(b) whether this raid had been carried
out by Enforcement Directorate (ED)
regarding money laundering or FEMA
related cases;
(c) if so, the present status thereof and
the action taken thereon; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Formation of regulator for settling
fare disputes
*284. SHRI B.S. GNANADESIKAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Directorate General of
Civil Aviation (DGCA) has proposed to
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

87
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
form a regulator to function as an arbitrator
in case there are disputes on fares between
consumers and airlines;
(b) if so, whether this regulator will
interfere in the matter of fares fixed by the
airlines according to market demand like
the lowest fare in first and highest fare at
the last moment; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Campaigns against female foeticides
*285. SHRIMATI JAYANTHI
NATARAJAN: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
highlight  the performance of women
sportspersons in the recently concluded
Commonwealth Games in its campaigns
against female foeticides and save the girl
child campaign;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the help of religious leaders
has also been sought to prevent female
foeticides in the country;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not the reasons therefor?
CPAP machines for CGHS
beneficiaries
*286. PROF. ANIL KUMAR
SAHANI: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of patients visiting
Safdarjung hospital per day and the doctor/
patient ratio, department-wise;
(b) whether Government contemplates
to increase the number of doctors in the
hospital;
(c) whether Continuous Pressure
Airway Pressure (CPAP) machine advised
by CGHS empanelled private hospitals to
CGHS beneficiaries is not being provided
by CGHS dispensaries without the
approval of Safdarjung hospital; and
(d) if so, the Nationale for availing facility
from CGHS empanelled private hospitals?
Measures for tackling hepatitis
*287. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether the Ministry supports the
May 2010, 63rd World Health Assembly
Resolution on viral hepatitis;
(b) whether there are almost 50,000
cases of liver cirrhosis and liver failure
arising out of hepatitis;
(c)  if so, what steps have been taken
by the Ministry to address this public
health problem, other than setting up
surveillance for Hepatitis B (HBV) and
Hepatitis C (HCV); and
(d) the details of preventive
interventions that the Ministry intends to
implement to prevent people from getting
HBV and HCV?
Cancellation of flights due to non-
availability of crew
*288. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) how many flights have been cancelled
during the last year due to the non-
availability of crew;
(b)  whether Government has taken any
steps to address this issue; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Utilization of Central funds given to
States
†*289. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the full benefits of the funds
given under various schemes by the Central

88
Government for the development of States
towards amenities and assistance of
common people do not reach the masses;
(b) if so, the names of these schemes;
(c) whether Government has made any
arrangement to ensure responsibility of the
authorities of concerned accountable
departments and to review and monitor the
utilization of funds given to States in public
interest;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Benefit of loan waiver for farmers in
Jharkhand
†*290. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than
1700 farmers of Deoghar Cooperative Grain
Bank of Jharkhand were not given benefits
of loan waiver under agriculture loan waiver
scheme in 2008;
(b)  whether Government will provide
the benefit of loan waiver by bringing BPL/
APL and small farmers under the scheme;
and
(c) whether Government is aware that
it would cost only ` 2.5 crore for extending
the benefit to these farmers?
Rural Development Project on
Bio-diesel
*291. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: W ill the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a)  the details and the latest status of
the proposal of the State Government of
Gujarat for funding of Rural Development
Project on Bio-diesel worth ` 2745.87 lakhs
for five years, i.e. 2008 to 2012-13;
(b) the reasons for its pendency; and
(c) by when the demanded funds are
likely to be released to the State
Government?
Proper use of computers in Gram
Panchayats in H.P.
†*292. SHRIMATI BIMLA
KASHYAP SOOD: Will the Minister of
PANCHAYATI RAJ be pleased to state:
(a)  whether the computers provided
by Government in all the Gram Panchayats
in the country, particularly in 3243
computer facilitated Gram Panchayats of
Himachal Pradesh, are  being properly used;
(b)  if so, whether Government has
provided any training to one representative
or Assistant or Secretary from each Gram
Panchayat to operate the computer;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Average age of Air India
employees
*293. SHRI NARESH GUJRAL: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a)  the number of employees Air India
has on its rolls at present;
(b)  the number of employees who will
retire over the next two years, i.e. till end
of 2011; and
(c) the average age of Air India
employees?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

89
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Tax Information Exchange Agreement
*294. SHRI RANJITSINH VIJAYSINH
MOHITE-PATIL: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a)  whether any proposal to sign an
agreement with the Virgin Islands and the
Isle of Man for exchange of information on
tax evasion by Indians is under
consideration of Government;
(b)  whether such a move of Government
will help to check parking of black money
slashed in foreign banks by Indians;
(c) whether Government has already
inked a Tax Information Exchange
Agreement with some foreign countries;
and
(d) if so, the names of those countries
with whom Government has already signed
such Agreement?
Participation of States in the
implementation of GST
†*295. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a)  whether Government has taken
cognizance of the demand of Maharashtra's
Finance Minister to implement Goods and
Service Tax (GST) by Centre and States
jointly and ensuring participation of all the
States in this process; and
(b)  if so, the details of the action being
taken by Government in this regard?
Delay in execution of PMGSY
projects in Orissa
*296. SHRI KISHORE KUMAR
MOHANTY: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of projects under
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
(PMGSY) which were not completed
within the stipulated time during the last
three years in Orissa;
(b)  whether the authorities concerned
have imposed penalty for the defaults in
the execution of such projects; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
number of projects along with the funds
sanctioned for them during the last three
years?
Setting up of medical
colleges
*297. DR. K.P. RAMALINGAM:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the seven member
Committee which replaced the Medical
Council of India (MCI) has recommended
to set up 100 medical colleges every five
year so that there is adequate number of
doctors by 2025; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken by Government on the
recommendation?
Passenger flights from Bidar airport
in Karnataka
*298. SHRI K.B. SHANAPPA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the approval for starting
passenger flights from Bidar airport is
awaited from the Ministry;
(b) if so, the reasons for delay; and
(c) whether it is a fact that temporary
terminal building has already been

90
constructed by the State Government of
Karnataka for Tricentenary Celebration of
Guru-da-gaddi in the year 2008?
WHO list of medicines for treatment
of  HIV/AIDS
*299. SHRI NAND KUMAR SAI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the World Health
Organisation (WHO) has released a list of
medicines for treatment of HIV/AIDS;
(b) if so, whether generic medicines
developed by Indian companies have also
been included in this list;
(c) whether some multinational
companies have termed the medicines
developed and manufactured by Indian
companies as inferior;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(e) whether these medicines were
included in the list of AIDS Control
Programme; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Mobilization of resources by
ONGC
*300. SHRI TAP AN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Oil and Natural Gas
Corporation (ONGC) is a debt free
company;
(b) if not, the debt equity ratio as on 31
March, 2010;
(c) whether ONGC is still planning to
mobilize resources through disinvestment
in capital market instead of approaching
debt market; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 24th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 3, 1932 (Saka)

91
I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)

Enterprises :—
